camel_example: aliyun sls GET /metricstores --project my-project --region cn-hangzhou --mode standard --offset 0 --size 100 --name metric_store --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the list of Metricstores in a project. You can use fuzzy search to query the Metricstores by Metricstore name
description_zh: 列出日志项目下的时序库，支持按照时序库名称模糊查找
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-metric-stores --project my-project --offset 0 --size 100 --biz-mode standard --name metric_store --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMetricStores

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 查询分页的页大小，一次请求最多返回的时序库数量
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The type of the Metricstore. For example, you can set the parameter to standard to query Standard Metricstores
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的时序库规格类型，例如 standard
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the Metricstore. Fuzzy search is supported. If you do not specify this parameter, all Metricstores are involved
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的时序库名称，支持模糊查询，此参数为空或者不传递此参数表示查询所有时序库
parameters.name: name
